_about: Measured from test/examples/Dubbed.mp4 and test/input/input.mp4. The reference is a three-panel clip comparing regional dubs (Hindi / English / Japanese) of one anime moment. It shows the target feel (energetic, colloquial, localised delivery over a lively soundtrack), NOT a script to copy and NOT a timeline to match. It has no transcript, so dialogue quality is judged by the Gemini judge in scripts/eval_dubbing.py, not by comparing text.
